# Research Experience

```{r}
#| results: asis
prep <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    mutate(date = resume_dates(start_date, end_date)) %>%
    select(role, institution, where, details, date) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
}
# One line per role:  **Role**, Institution          Date
resume_lines <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    filter(!is.na(role)) %>%
    mutate(latex = paste0(
      "\\cvline{\\textbf{", escape_latex(role), "}, ", escape_latex(institution), "}{", date, "}"
    )) %>%
    pull(latex) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
    cat("\\begingroup\\setlength{\\parskip}{2pt}\n", ., "\n\\endgroup\n", sep = "")
}
# All research roles, same as the CV
resume_lines(prep(get_cv_sheet('research')))
```

# Selected Publications
\underline{Underline} indicates mentee; * corresponding

```{r}
#| results: asis
get_cv_sheet('pubs') %>%
  filter(category %in% c("peer_reviewed", "under_review", "preprint")) %>%
  filter(pick_for_resume(.)) %>%
  mutate(
    status   = case_when(
                 category == "under_review" ~ " (Under Review)",
                 category == "preprint" & is.na(journal) ~ "Preprint",
                 TRUE ~ ""),
    journal  = paste0(ifelse(is.na(journal), '', paste0('_', fmt_venue(journal), '_')), status),
    journal  = ifelse(journal == '', '', paste0(journal, '.')),
    doi      = clean_doi(doi),
    doi      = case_when(
                 !is.na(doi) ~ paste0('DOI: [', doi, '](https://doi.org/', doi, ')'),
                 !is.na(url_repo) ~ paste0('[GitHub](', url_repo, ')'),
                 TRUE ~ ''),
    order    = match(category, c("peer_reviewed", "under_review", "preprint")),
    # Undergraduate mentees: underline only, no **
    author   = str_replace_all(author, "\\\\\\*\\\\\\*([\\p{L}'-]+)", "\\\\underline{\\1}"),
    citation = str_squish(paste0(author, " (", year, ") ", enquote(title), " ", journal, " ", doi)),
    citation = str_replace_all(citation, "\\s+,", ",")
  ) %>%
  arrange(order, desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(category = "all") %>%
  make_ordered_list_filtered("all")
```
